name: jei
description: The parts of an IDE you still need when the AI writes the code: a file tree, project search and a full Git panel, docked beside your Claude Code or OpenCode session.

startOpen.title: Open on start
startOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts (where it can dock).

defaultTab.title: Default tab
defaultTab.description: Tab shown when the pane opens.

activity.title: Activity shimmer
activity.description: What the shimmer shows in the file tree and the Git tab.

followAgent.title: Follow the agent
followAgent.description: The tree follows the files the agent touches.

glyphs.title: Icon set
glyphs.description: Icons: auto-detect, Nerd Font, or plain characters.

editorCommand.title: Editor command
editorCommand.description: Command that opens a file; {path} and {line} are replaced. Empty uses the system default.

commitModel.title: Commit message model
commitModel.description: Model used by Generate. Empty uses the host default.

smartCommit.title: Smart commit
smartCommit.description: Commit with nothing staged stages everything first.

graphLimit.title: Graph page size
graphLimit.description: Commits loaded per page in the Git graph.
